context_for_next_testing_agent: DYNAMIC CONTENT SETTINGS FULLY FUNCTIONAL. APIs tested: GET /api/settings/translations (returns 12 translations), GET /api/settings/symptom-chips (returns 10 chips with id, de, it, icon, order), GET /api/settings/disclaimer (returns structured disclaimer for de and it). Frontend: SettingsProvider wraps all screens in _layout.tsx, fetches settings on mount, components use useSettings() hook to access dynamic data. The t() function in i18n.ts accepts 3rd parameter 'dynamicOverrides' that takes priority over hardcoded values. Admin panel at /api/admin-app has tabs: Produkte, Rezepte, Texte (translations), Symptom-Chips, Disclaimer, KI-Einstellungen, Klicks, Logs, Supplements. Onboarding wizard (6 steps) works correctly.
